description: Live coupon codes and deals for one store, best first: exclusive codes, then codes our team verified most recently. Each offer has the discount, what it applies to, the date our team last verified it at checkout, and either a code to type at checkout or a link the shopper must open first.

country.description: Shopper's country as a 2-letter code: US, IN, AE, SG, MY or JP. Any other value (or none) uses the CouponBricks global site.

store.description: Store name or slug from search_stores.

name: get_coupons
title: Get tested coupons for a store
